_note: Approved storyboard cuts are converted into motion-friendly keyframes. Scene-01 starts from kf-01, and every later scene must inherit the previous scene's final frame state before motion continues.

episode.basis: approved storyboard cuts -> brief lock -> motion-ready keyframes -> sequential scene-video generation

continuityRules.entryFrameRule: scene-01 starts from the approved keyframe anchor; later scenes start from the previous scene's final frame state
continuityRules.boundaryRule: scene-n final frame and scene-(n+1) opening frame should begin from the same state before motion continues
continuityRules.identityRule: Jjiroo, Jjonga, harness colors, and riverbank geography must stay unchanged across the whole episode
continuityRules.toneRule: comic anecdote only; ducks are evasive, mother is worried, Jjiroo is impulsive but not aggressive

keyframes.purpose: establish walk, cast, and readable Tancheon geography
keyframes.pose: Jjiroo and Jjonga walking lightly along the riverside path in harness, mother behind them, open daylight and shallow river visible
keyframes.cameraIntent: gentle vertical medium-wide opening pan with calm observational energy
keyframes.continuityIn: cold open into bright daytime path and river relationship
keyframes.motionBeat: easy paw steps, leash sway, mild grass movement, relaxed rhythm
keyframes.continuityOut: Jjiroo shifts slightly lower and closer to sniffing behavior while preserving the same walk direction

keyframes.purpose: build slice-of-life calm before the trigger
keyframes.pose: low-angle dog-height view of Jjiroo sniffing the ground while Jjonga stays nearby and the mother is partially framed above
keyframes.cameraIntent: subtle handheld drift near dog height
keyframes.continuityIn: inherits the same riverside path, dog positions, and harness lock from scene-01
keyframes.motionBeat: nose-to-ground sniffing, tail flicks, tiny weight shifts
keyframes.continuityOut: Jjiroo's attention starts to lift toward the riverbank where ducks rest

keyframes.pose: Jjiroo frozen in alert reaction with ears up, ducks readable in the distance near the bank, Jjonga secondary
keyframes.cameraIntent: reaction push-in that keeps Jjiroo foregrounded and ducks legible in the same frame
keyframes.continuityIn: Jjiroo lifts from sniffing into a locked sightline without changing location logic
keyframes.motionBeat: eye snap, ear perk, micro head turn toward the ducks
keyframes.continuityOut: body lowers into a stalking posture while the ducks remain in the same geography

keyframes.purpose: build stalking tension before the burst
keyframes.pose: Jjiroo crouched low with intense forward focus, harness taut, ducks still ahead, riverbank readable
keyframes.cameraIntent: slow lateral creep from side profile
keyframes.continuityIn: same dog-to-duck line from scene-03, now compressed into pre-sprint tension
keyframes.motionBeat: careful paw steps, body compression, leash tension, held suspense
keyframes.continuityOut: the held crouch releases into a forward launch toward the ducks

keyframes.pose: Jjiroo sprinting diagonally after breaking free, ducks scattering toward the water, mother lagging behind, Jjonga back on shore
keyframes.continuityIn: explodes directly from the stalking release without resetting the camera direction
keyframes.motionBeat: sprint blur, duck flutter, strong directional flow toward the river
keyframes.continuityOut: Jjiroo reaches the same readable bank edge where the water entry will happen next

keyframes.purpose: scale the incident up by putting Jjiroo into the water
keyframes.pose: Jjiroo launching into or just hitting the shallow river with a big splash at the exact bank entry point established in scene-05
keyframes.cameraIntent: fast drop into splash impact while preserving entry-point clarity
keyframes.continuityIn: same directional momentum from the sprint, no geography reset
keyframes.motionBeat: air-to-water transition, splash burst, startled shore reaction behind
keyframes.continuityOut: Jjiroo is now clearly in the river and moving ahead of everyone else

keyframes.pose: mother entering the river behind while Jjiroo already swims ahead midstream and ducks stay farther in front
keyframes.cameraIntent: forward chase framing with layered depth
keyframes.continuityIn: mother reacts from the same bank and water entry area established in scene-06
keyframes.motionBeat: water churn, arm reach, widening distance between mother and Jjiroo
keyframes.continuityOut: the gap between them increases and the river lane becomes the main action axis

keyframes.purpose: peak the absurdity without turning it into danger
keyframes.pose: Jjiroo confidently swimming upstream ahead, mother struggling behind, ducks escaping farther away and out of reach
keyframes.cameraIntent: vertical tracking follow along the river lane
keyframes.continuityIn: inherits the chase line and spacing from scene-07
keyframes.motionBeat: steady swim rhythm, ripples, rescue strain behind, ducks clearing the frame
keyframes.continuityOut: Jjiroo decides to abandon the chase and redirect toward the climb-out bank

keyframes.purpose: lock the self-rescue clearly before the reaction beat
keyframes.pose: wet Jjiroo climbing out of the river on his own at the readable bank exit while the mother remains in the water behind
keyframes.cameraIntent: easing pullback toward the climb-out point
keyframes.continuityIn: same river geography, now pivoting from pursuit to recovery
keyframes.motionBeat: front paws finding ground, wet body hauling up, relief replacing chase energy
keyframes.continuityOut: Jjiroo reaches dry land, turns his body back toward the mother, and settles into a reaction hold

keyframes.purpose: land the clean final laugh and replay value
keyframes.pose: Jjiroo safely on the bank, dripping but calm, head slightly tilted toward the soaked mother behind him with a puzzled innocent look
keyframes.cameraIntent: mostly locked comedy hold with Jjiroo foregrounded and the mother in water behind
keyframes.continuityIn: starts from the exact climb-out state reached in scene-09
keyframes.motionBeat: small blink, tiny head tilt, reaction hold long enough for the joke to register
keyframes.continuityOut: end on a still-readable bank-versus-water composition suitable for loop or hard end

reviewChecklist: 찌루와 쫑아의 털색, 귀 모양, 하네스 색이 전 장면에서 유지되는가
탄천 강변 지형이 duck sighting, water entry, climb-out까지 같은 장소로 읽히는가
오리가 다치거나 사냥당하는 느낌 없이 놀라서 피하는 톤으로 보이는가
어머니는 구조자 맥락만 주고 화면 중심은 끝까지 찌루에 남는가
scene-05에서 scene-10까지 액션 방향이 끊기지 않고 이어지는가
generated keyframe에 텍스트, 숫자, 로고, 워터마크가 없는가
scene-10의 표정이 위험 해소보다 코믹 아이러니로 먼저 읽히는가
